rules.name: Credentials Transmitted Over Unencrypted Channel
rules.description: Detects login or credential submission over HTTP instead of HTTPS exposing credentials to interception
rules.query: SELECT "siem_general_wstg04_001", "action" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'VcnFlowLogs' AND "action" = 'REJECT' AND "srcaddr" NOT LIKE '10.%' AND "dstaddr" NOT LIKE '10.%' AND "value" > 0

rules.name: Default Credentials Usage on Login
rules.description: Detects successful logins using common default usernames like admin, root, or test across services
rules.query: SELECT "siem_general_wstg04_002", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%default%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%credentials%') AND "value" > 0
